title: Fenwick: engine integration workshop

sentences.speaker: Tomasz Wolniak
sentences.text: Our engineers are wrapping the REST API by hand inside Unity every sprint.

sentences.speaker: Aiko Sato
sentences.text: A native Unity plugin would cut that, and an Unreal one is next on our list.

sentences.speaker: Aiko Sato
sentences.text: Our other pain is pronunciation. Fantasy names get mangled, and we re-record constantly.

sentences.speaker: Priya Raman
sentences.text: A pronunciation dictionary would fix that class of problem.

sentences.speaker: Tomasz Wolniak
sentences.text: Yes. Add words once, and every voice respects them.

sentences.speaker: Priya Raman
sentences.text: I will write both asks up for product.

summary: Fenwick wants a native Unity plugin (Unreal next) and a pronunciation dictionary for character names. No contract date.
action_items: Priya to write up Unity plugin and pronunciation dictionary asks
